upstream: Open Addresses UK (Open Addresses Ltd, openaddressesuk.org, discontinued)
attribution: unverifiable: the openaddressesuk.org site is offline; the libpostal README states CC-BY and the project's ODI Open Data Certificate and contributor terms state Creative Commons Attribution 4.0. The attribution string to use pending a verifiable archived statement is 'Contains data from Open Addresses UK, CC BY 4.0'
constraints: this is a different project from openaddresses.io; it is the only UK address source in the libpostal set
Open Addresses UK derived part of its data from crowdsourcing and part from open government sources; the ODI certificate records that rights are held by several parties
if 0.4 cannot confirm the CC-BY-4.0 statement from an archived copy of openaddressesuk.org, the file is dropped and GB parser data comes from OSM only
format: gzipped TSV, three columns: language (ISO 639-1), country (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 lowercase), tagged address. The address column is space-separated token/label pairs, for example 'Parkstraße/road 8/house_number |/FSEP 6OG/level'; '|/FSEP' marks a field separator and ',/SEP' a separator token. Verified by streaming the first bytes of the 20170304 file on 2026-09-22.
notes: README label: '(CC-BY): addresses from OpenAddresses UK'. Size: 26611979 bytes. Training set date 20170304 from the repository file current_parser_training_set (verified 2026-09-22). The README lists the files under https://archive.org/download/libpostal-parser-training-data-YYYYMMDD/; the older libpostal.s3.amazonaws.com location returns 403.
